gameDescriptionHtml:
Some trails should remain untouched.

A new episode of the Tales Beyond The Tomb series – colder, more isolated, and more disturbing than ever.

Inspired by real events that were never fully explained, this chapter takes the player to a remote mountain range haunted by wind, ice, and secrets buried beneath the snow.

With a suffocating atmosphere, immersive audio design, and moments of pure psychological horror, this is a journey back to a place that was never meant to be rediscovered.

Episode 4: White Silence – Years ago, a group of young explorers vanished during an expedition into a remote and frozen mountain region. Weeks later, their bodies were found scattered across the terrain – barefoot, wounded, and frozen in expressions of sheer terror. The case was quickly closed. No answers. No survivors. Now, you play as a determined investigator, returning to the scene in search of the truth. Accompanied only by a local guide, you must retrace the steps of the doomed expedition, confronting the freezing cold, growing isolation, and the eerie feeling that something – or someone – still lingers in those mountains. Every step brings you closer to the truth. But some truths should never be uncovered.

Game Features

  • VHS Aesthetic – Go back in time with visuals inspired by classic horror films from the 80s and 90s.
  • Photorealistic Graphics and Immersive Environments – Feel the terror with realistic visuals and terrifying environments.
  • Exploration – Discover tapes, documents, and remnants of the original expedition.
  • End – An ambiguous, disturbing ending – just like the case it’s inspired by.
  • Dialogue Text System – Immerse yourself in the story with dynamic, narrative dialogue.
  • Cold and Insanity – Sometimes the freezing winds of the mountains can cause some disturbances and hallucinations.
